AATMT v1.0.0 — the first release of the AI Automation Task Management tool: capture requests from your manager (messages + screenshots), group tasks by project, and let the AI providers you configure analyse, plan and do the work while you track every stage.

## Download

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows (installer, recommended)** | `AATMT-Setup-v1.0.0-x64.exe` (Intel/AMD) · `AATMT-Setup-v1.0.0-arm64.exe` (ARM) |
| Windows (portable) | `aatmt-v1.0.0-windows-amd64.zip` · `aatmt-v1.0.0-windows-arm64.zip` |
| macOS | `aatmt-v1.0.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` (Apple Silicon) · `aatmt-v1.0.0-darwin-amd64.tar.gz` (Intel) |
| Linux | `aatmt-v1.0.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz` · `aatmt-v1.0.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`.

### Windows installer
Run the setup file → Next → Install. It installs for the current user (no administrator rights), adds Start-menu and optional desktop shortcuts, and can start AATMT at sign-in. Launching AATMT opens `http://127.0.0.1:8787` in your browser; closing its console window stops it. Uninstall from *Settings → Apps*; your data in `%APPDATA%\aatmt` is kept.

The installer and the binary are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" — choose *More info → Run anyway*.

### macOS / Linux
Extract and run `./aatmt -open`. On macOS, the first run of an unsigned binary may need: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine ./aatmt`.

## Highlights
- Projects: one codebase shared by many tasks, with a knowledge base, commands, skills, file browser and git info
- Task pipeline Inbox → Analyzing → Planned → In progress → Review → Done, with chat, activity, graph, diffs/revert, LLM records and Markdown reports
- Bring your own AI endpoints (OpenAI-compatible incl. Azure/Gemini/OpenRouter/Ollama/company gateways, and Anthropic) with per-agent failover chains
- MCP servers (Streamable HTTP, SSE, stdio) as extra agent tools
- Command rules + approval audit, webhooks, templates, dashboard
- Token saving: screenshots read once, compact brief instead of chat replay, budgeted code context, prompt caching
- No hard-coded limits: every limit and timeout is editable in Settings → Limits; token estimates use measured chars/token and real image sizes; costs use only the prices you enter
